title: kithctl watch does not use TLS 1.2 or 1.3 version restriction
description: watch.rs build_tls_connector uses ClientConfig::builder().dangerous().with_custom_certificate_verifier(). This does not restrict TLS version. rustls defaults are TLS 1.2 and 1.3 so this is fine in practice, but it is worth an explicit comment noting that rustls enforces this. No code change needed; just a comment to prevent future confusion if the crypto provider changes.
